prompt: What penalties face a minor convicted of a first-offense DUI (Driving Under the Influence of Alcohol)?

options.text: Class C misdemeanor, fine up to $500, 20-40 hours community service, 60-day suspension
Class A misdemeanor carrying mandatory six months confinement in state prison
A ten-dollar administrative fine without any impact on Texas driving privileges
Automatic expulsion from all Texas public high schools and state universities
